scope.comparisonBasis: remote git ls-files vs Z8 complete-project-manifest.json paths, with common content compared against current Z8 files

latestRemoteCommits.subject: Record focused or full native verification when staging desktop artifacts
Respect focused validation and separate app and window lifecycle listeners
Start the managed HTTP host without blocking reverse DNS
Capture child startup stacks without altering the module entrypoint

remoteOnlyProductOrReleaseChanges.remoteBehavior: The Python stager reads run jobs and requires all three native target jobs to succeed in the same full or focused mode; it checks mode-specific required steps (including Windows download and full-mode installed update gates). It invokes tools/prepare_release.py, verifies source archive against release/manifest.json, includes the source tarball and source-manifest.json, and writes build-info.json with nativePlatforms and verificationMode.
remoteOnlyProductOrReleaseChanges.z8ObservedBehavior: The TS stager checks completed/success, exact head SHA and workflow name, then validates downloaded artifact SHA-256 lists and update-feed SHA-512/size. Its run query does not request jobs or inspect step conclusions; it does not emit build-info.json/verificationMode or add a source tarball/source-manifest.json. It allows updating an existing draft with --clobber but rejects published tags; the Python stager errors if any tag already exists.

remoteOnlyProductOrReleaseChanges.area: managed HTTP server reverse-DNS startup fix
remoteOnlyProductOrReleaseChanges.remoteBehavior: The Python ThreadingHTTPServer override calls TCPServer.server_bind and assigns server_name/server_port directly so HTTPServer.server_bind does not call socket.getfqdn for a numeric local address.
remoteOnlyProductOrReleaseChanges.z8ObservedBehavior: The Z8 server is TypeScript/Node and calls server.listen(port, host); the Python HTTPServer code path is absent. This is an old-runtime-specific fix; no direct Python implementation exists in Z8.

behaviorAlreadyPresentInZ8.area: macOS app/window listener lifecycle regression coverage
behaviorAlreadyPresentInZ8.fact: The remote a10c584 listener assertions are present in Z8: app-scoped notification listeners remain after window close, window-scoped background/tray handlers are disposed and recreated, and notification handlers are not duplicated. Z8 also adds desktop-storage IPC checks in this test.
